sources.title: Turbulence.ai: an end-to-end AI scientist for fluid mechanics
sources.snippet: Turbulence.ai, the system presented in this work, aims to push this concept further: to create an AI Scientist for fluid mechanics that can autonomously conduct the entire research procedure, from problem formulation through simulation and analysis.
